blind.description: A classic wooden sand timer / hourglass. It consists of circular top and bottom wooden plates connected by three turned wooden support pillars, enclosing a central double-bulb glass vessel. The bottom chamber of the glass bulb contains orange and pale yellowish sand. The wood has a polished brown grain texture, and all surfaces are smooth, continuous, and cleanly modeled.
blind.from_above: A circular brown wooden disc with a concentric grain pattern, casting a distinct hourglass-shaped shadow onto the floor.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1 foot / 30 cm tall) and about 6 to 8 inches wide.
